theme: Last day on land before Croatia.
greeting: It's a travel day, Dan. The boat and the Adriatic are twelve days out, but they begin tonight the moment TPA lifts off. The loops worth closing this morning are the ones that go quiet the instant you're aboard.

needsAttention.title: Carol Hansell wants to reconnect
needsAttention.detail: She writes that she dropped the ball and asks you to send times that work. Worth a reply before you lose signal for two weeks.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued fare shows 0 checked bags on both Eurowings Discover legs. You fly tonight, so verify on the operating carrier and buy bags online now if they're missing.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night + transfer
needsAttention.detail: The last night after the charter is still unbooked. Real deadline is today, not the 19th, since the boat has almost no connectivity once you board.

needsAttention.title: Book St Pete landing-gap lodging
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-22, the two nights between landing at TPA and the Tuesday kid pickup, still has no room held.

needsAttention.title: Contact the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Confirm Saturday boarding time and location and arrange the Sept 19 return transfer. Easier from land than once the course is underway.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since the 5th, and it's a blocker. The Oct 18 rotation booking fires while you're at sea, so this can't wait for the far side of the trip.

schedule.title: Rental car back at TPA
schedule.detail: St. Pete checkout was 10 AM; car returns around noon.

flagged.title: Carol Hansell reconnect
flagged.detail: "Still there?" - she's asking you to propose times.

flagged.title: Andrew Kaufmann InMail
flagged.detail: A contact from last December resurfaced on LinkedIn after a bounced email, still keen to talk.

flagged.title: Clarke Customer Care invoice
flagged.detail: Invoice for the 7/31 appliance repair is now due.

inbox.noise: Otherwise newsletters and promos: NYT Cooking, Monocle, Responsible Investor, Qatar Airways, Heathrow, Duke Homecoming.
inbox.clear: Boarding passes for both legs are already in your inbox, and the St. Pete Airbnb thread closed out at checkout.

context.location: St. Petersburg, FL - flying to Croatia tonight

recipe.title: Butternut squash & candied bacon on fresh pasta
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first winter squash to the markets — sweet, dense, and worth the roast.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: A quiet stretch on the ground, the last one before twelve days on the water.
The rental's due back at TPA around noon; nothing else sits on the calendar.
The flight to Frankfurt lifts off, and Croatia begins on the far side of the night.
